title: Chapter 377: An Ordinary Housekeeper
content:
Chapter 377: An Ordinary Housekeeper

"aunt!"

Seeing Jiang Xiaoxiao fainting, Lu Xue looked a little panicked.

Regardless of the gazes of the people around him, Lu Xue picked up Jiang Xiaoxiao and rushed towards the deserted city.

Left a few people standing in the wind and being messy.

In this way, time seemed to have stopped for a few seconds.

The leader of the Shadow Clan sat on the ground with a shocked and suspicious face.

"It's over, it's over now."

Looking at the Shadow Clan leader who was walking back and forth in front of him, An Changzai and the other two finally became a little impatient.

"Captain Dark Clan, are you so uneasy?"

"nonsense!"

The Shadow Clan leader rarely increased the volume, and then the three of them noticed that the Shadow Clan leader's face was filled with sweat at some point.

My brother was sweating profusely.

"I, I suddenly felt a little uncomfortable, and I couldn't breathe."

Suddenly, the aura of the Shadow Clan leader weakened again, as if he would die in the next moment.

"Captain Dark Clan, are you scared by that monster?"

Seeing the Shadow Clan leader like this, how could the three of them guess what the Shadow Clan leader was thinking.

Huo Xingzhi then said sarcastically to the leader of the Shadow Clan.

"I, my dignified Shadow Clan leader, would I be scared by a monster of unknown origin?"

"Then why are you,"

"I'm. I've tried too hard to revenge against the Gods before, and now I'm a little weak."

"Yes, yes, that's it. I'm really sorry. I'm telling the Lord of the Palace for me that I'm going to go into seclusion and recuperate, otherwise there may be hidden diseases. I'm going to take the lead."

As soon as he finished speaking, the head of the Shadow Clan flashed and ran under the noses of the three.

The three of them looked at each other, all with ugly eyes.

Sure enough, the Shadow Clan is not reliable at all.

However, their human race would not expect the Shadows to help him deal with the monsters.

As long as the Shadow Clan is not stabbed at that time, it will be enough.

"What should I do now?"

Wu Shang, who had been silent all the time, suddenly spoke.

Hearing this, the two were a little silent.

An Chang looked towards the direction of the deserted city and whispered: "Wait patiently."

Even Lu Xue's aunt is not the opponent of that monster. Do you still expect them?

So if nothing unexpected happens next, either Lu Xue's mysterious father will come back, or the background behind Lu Xue will emerge.

Anyway, they don’t believe that Lu Xue will die.

She is the successor of the Human Emperor.

At the same time, inside the deserted city.

"Miss, is this?"

An Xing was the first to appear beside Lu Xue. Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao who was seriously injured and unconscious, the smile on her face instantly disappeared and turned into a touch of solemnity.

This is Lu Xue's aunt, I don't know how strong she is.

Now he has been beaten like this.

It's terrible to think about it carefully.

"Mom, where is my mother?"

Lu Xue asked anxiously.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, An Xing looked shaking, "Miss, wait a moment, I'll go back."

Seeing An Xing disappearing from the spot, Lu Xue frowned slightly, was silent for a moment, and took Jiang Xiaoxiao towards the city lord's mansion.

It seems that my aunt is not as simple as being injured.

It seems that it was contaminated by that monster.

If it lasts for a long time, maybe life will be in danger.

Lu Xue guessed it well. Jiang Xiaoxiao was indeed infected by the monster's erosion power at this moment. In a short while, Jiang Xiaoxiao will become a monster like that creature!

Seeing Jiang Xiaoxiao's complexion getting worse and worse, the erosion power on her body began to become stronger and stronger.

Lu Xue's figure unconsciously accelerated a little.

In just a moment, I arrived at the city lord's mansion.

"Miss, you're back."

As soon as he entered the city lord's mansion, an old man with a kind face appeared in front of Lu Xue.

"Old Jiang."

When Lu Xue saw the old man, he nodded slightly and said hello.

Mr. Jiang is the housekeeper of the City Lord’s Mansion, and it has been since her birth.

In addition to Awei, Mr. Jiang is the one who has been with his father for the longest time.

However, Mr. Jiang has no ambitions and just wants to help Lu Daosheng manage the affairs in the mansion well.

In this regard, Lu Daosheng did not give Mr. Jiang any extra position.

But in the entire deserted city, no matter who is anyone, he will be respectful when he sees Mr. Jiang.

At this time, Mr. Jiang also noticed Jiang Xiaoxiao who was seriously injured and unconscious, and his turbid eyes suddenly showed a little shrewdness.

"This girl is sick."

Mr. Jiang's voice was slightly deeper and he sighed.

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked sad, "Old Jiang, this is my aunt. She is not sick, but was injured by an evil monster, and she became like this."

Lu Xue explained patiently.

Mr. Jiang nodded slightly, "It's almost the same. If you don't have treatment, you'll probably be alive."

"Miss, come with me."

Old Jiang spoke softly and then headed towards the depths of the deserted city.

Looking at Old Jiang's back, Lu Xue was slightly stunned and followed by a devil.

Huh? Why did you follow me?

It’s important to save people.

Can Mr. Jiang save his aunt?

No, Mr. Jiang is just a small butler in the City Lord’s Mansion. What abilities can he have?

Just when Lu Xue was thinking a lot, Mr. Jiang had already stopped.

"arrive."

Lu Xue came to her senses and found that she had arrived in front of a secluded pool at some time.

Um? When did such a place exist in the deserted city? I didn’t even know as the eldest lady of the deserted city.

I saw fog everywhere on the pool. It was not the water vapor generated by the high water temperature, but the water pool contained all the essence of the world and the manifestation of energy overflowing.

"Miss, put your aunt in and the water can wash away the pollution in your aunt's body."

Mr. Jiang smiled slightly at Lu Xue and spoke indifferently.

Hearing this, Lu Xue glanced at Mr. Jiang deeply, and then quickly put Jiang Xiaoxiao gently in the pool.

The moment Jiang Xiaoxiao's body touched the pool, wisps of black air suddenly flew out of Jiang Xiaoxiao's body.

These wisps of black air were extremely aggressive, and they just floated in the air for a while and then quickly attacked Lu Xue.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue's face changed drastically and she was about to retreat.

And at this moment, Mr. Jiang, who was standing beside him, suddenly took action.

A dazzling golden light shot out from Old Jiang's palms, and the black air suddenly disappeared.

"this,,"

Lu Xue stood there, completely confused, and had to stare at Old Jiang blankly.

After a long time, Lu Xue hesitated and said, "Old Jiang, you are hiding your weakness."

Upon hearing this, Mr. Jiang smiled, "I am just an ordinary butler."

Ordinary.

Listen, no one can say.

Lu Xue took a deep breath, her face was speechless, but her heart relaxed.

The deserted city is really full of talents.

My father is really, I don’t know how many strong men have been arranged in the deserted city.

I'm afraid Mr. Jiang is definitely not the only one.

Looking at Jiang Xiaoxiao who had already stabilized, Lu Xue pondered for a moment and suddenly said, "Kong, Kong! Where are you? Come out quickly!"

She knew that Kong was a strong man trained by her father himself, and she had secretly protected her for a long time.

The words fell.

The shadow behind Lu Xue suddenly began to squirm.

The next moment, a figure covered in darkness appeared beside Lu Xue.

"Miss, are you looking for me?"
